title: Normal People
creator: Sally Rooney
summary: Two people who keep finding and losing each other across years. A book about the gap between what we feel and what we say.
personalNote: Rooney writes interiority like no one else. You spend the whole book frustrated that they won't just talk to each other — and then you realise that's the point. The miscommunication isn't a plot device. It's the subject. I recognised too much of myself in both of them.
